evals.prompt: Leadership wants an AI chatbot in checkout next quarter. Frame the discovery without accepting the solution or starting delivery.
assertions: Reframes the chatbot request into an affected-user problem and current journey with explicit exclusions
Separates available evidence from assumptions and identifies the highest-consequence weakly supported assumptions
Defines a measurable outcome, guardrails, smallest useful tests, and a proceed/change/pause/stop boundary without approving delivery

evals.prompt: Compare three interventions for reducing failed identity checks. The evidence conflicts and each stakeholder has a preferred option.
assertions: Compares every option against the same outcome, evidence, feasibility, cost, risk, reversibility, and whole-journey dimensions
Preserves contradictory evidence and sensitivity to disputed assumptions instead of collapsing them into an unexplained score
Returns a recommendation with dissent, unresolved uncertainty, and the next evidence boundary

evals.prompt: We have a baseline but no reliable target or guardrails. Design the smallest product discovery that can support a decision.
assertions: Pins population, measurement window, leading and lagging indicators, target rationale, and guardrails
Chooses tests that can disconfirm the proposed intervention and names the result that would change or stop it
Produces a traceable product-definition handoff without creating stories or an implementation plan
